description: This file defines the 'OAuthClientSearchFilterParams' class used for filtering search parameters of OAuth clients within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base filter parameters class and specifies allowed sort fields, initializing the default sort by 'oauthClient.id'.

classes.name: OAuthClientSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A class for defining filter parameters specific to OAuth client searches, including allowed sorting fields and default sorting behavior.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field 'oauthClient.id'.
